•	 Folic acid supplementation (400 mg/day) should be part of a routine mineral-containing bariatric 
multivitamin preparation.
•	 Routine supplementation with zinc, selenium, and copper in addition to the amount found in 
the bariatric multivitamins–minerals preparation is not recommended.
It is important to mention that many of these recommendations are based mainly on expert 
opinion, and more clinical studies in this area are needed.
